dashboard.baseline_note: Baselines compare each recording with earlier recordings from the same site, the same part of the day (dawn, day, dusk, night) and the same weeks of the year across seasons, using the median and MAD. Richness is species with at least one counted detection event.

sites.name: Mill pond edge

alerts.title: Dawn species richness fell at North pasture
alerts.detail: The last 6 dawn recordings at North pasture counted a median of 7 species. The baseline for dawn recordings in these weeks across 2025 and 2026 is 13 species (MAD 2, from 48 comparable recordings). That is 3 MADs below the baseline.
alerts.suggested_action: Check whether the first hay cut or grazing moved the birds, listen to two of the recordings, and compare with Mill pond edge for the same mornings.

alerts.title: Bobolink detected at North pasture
alerts.detail: Bobolink (Dolichonyx oryzivorus), a priority species for this organization, produced 4 detection events with a maximum confidence of 0.91 in the recording of Sep 28, 06:00.
alerts.suggested_action: Listen to the events and accept or reject them so the record is reviewed.

alerts.title: Three recordings in a row rated not usable at Mill pond edge
alerts.detail: The last 3 recordings from Mill pond edge were rated not usable: energy below 200 Hz was 61%, 58% and 66% of the total, which usually means wind or rain on the microphone.
alerts.suggested_action: Check the windscreen and whether the recorder is still shielded by the bank.

alerts.title: SM Mini (hedgerow) has not recorded for 46 days
alerts.detail: The last recording from SM Mini (hedgerow) arrived on Aug 14. With the deployment interval of 60 minutes, about 1,100 recordings were expected since then. The gap rule is 3 times the median interval and at least 6 hours.
alerts.suggested_action: Collect the card and check the batteries; end the deployment if the recorder was removed.

alerts.title: Moth 2 battery at 3.7 V
alerts.detail: The latest AudioMoth comment reports 3.7 V. The low threshold for AudioMoth is 3.6 V.
alerts.suggested_action: Plan a battery change at the next card swap.

alerts.title: First Gray Treefrog at Mill pond edge
alerts.detail: Gray Treefrog (Hyla versicolor) was counted at Mill pond edge for the first time: 3 detection events, maximum confidence 0.84.
